title: Atherosclerosis: From Pathogenesis to Therapeutic Interventions.
snippet: Atherosclerosis is no longer viewed solely as a lipid-storage disorder but rather as a complex multisystem inflammatory disease driven by interactions among the vascular, immune, metabolic, and nervous systems.
